## Synopsis

Asks Straza to list the server's objects now, for example after a repo was created.
One strazad replica runs the listing within 30 seconds, and every replica holds the
result after that. A server listed less than a minute ago refuses, and the answer
says when to try again. The listing writes its record to the audit log.

```
strazactl apps objects refresh <server> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  strazactl apps objects refresh objects-demo
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER)
```
